text.en:
The percentage of net earnings to be declared and remitted by the
LBP and NEA as dividends to the National Government as provided for under Section 3 of
Republic Act No. 7656 is adjusted from at least fifty percent (50%) to the rates specified
1. Land Bank of the Philippines
2. National Electrification Administration

The adjusted dividend rates provided for under Section 1 are only
applicable on 1997 net earnings of the concerned government-owned and/or controlled
corporations.
